items.title: NASA Science
items.summary: Beauty is in the eye of the beholder. And there is much to behold in today's featured image. The Milky Way shines bright in the sky of Brazil, over the white sand dunes and dark lagoons of Lençóis Maranhenses National Park. We can see different parts of the Milky Way as it apparently rotates in the sky every night and throughout the year. items.title: דוב קוטב
items.summary: דוב קוטב (שם מדעי: Ursus maritimus) או דוב לבן הוא דוב האנדמי לאזור הארקטי. לצד דובי הקודיאק, דובי הקוטב הם הטורפים היבשתיים הגדולים ביותר: הזכרים הבוגרים שוקלים בין 300 ל-700 קילוגרם והנקבות שוקלות כחצי ממשקל הזכרים. פרוותם חלולה ושקופה למחצה, אולם לצופים מרחוק היא נראית בצבע לבן או בז', והיא מספקת לדובים הסוואה. עורם של דובי הקוטב שחור.

items.label: From the classics
items.title: Laozi — Tao Teh King
items.summary: All difficult things in the world are sure to arise from a previous state in which they were easy, and all great things from one in which they were small.

items.label: Poem
items.title: Homer — The Iliad
items.summary:
’Twas when, emerging through the shades of night,
The morning planet told the approach of light;
And, fast behind, Aurora’s warmer ray
O’er the broad ocean pour’d the golden day:
items.source: Book XXIII · trans. Alexander Pope · Project Gutenberg

items.title: Meet Earth's New 'Mini-Moon' 2026 QQ8, a Six-Foot-Wide Asteroid That's Temporarily Circling Our Planet
items.summary: An astronomer first spotted the object in August, but scientists needed several weeks to determine whether it was natural or human-made. Earth's gravity captured 2026 QQ8 in April, and the space rock will leave us in December or January

items.label: Discovery
items.title: Scientists Discover Signs of Explosive Volcanic Eruptions 20,000 Feet Underwater—the Deepest Ever Found—in the Mariana Trench
items.summary: The discovery puzzles researchers because volcanic activity at that depth should produce a goopy, seeping flow due to the immense pressure. Nevertheless, they say they've found evidence of explosive volcanism, thanks to a remotely operated submersible
